Son of God! thy people’s shield! Prayer for the Lord’s promised presence
John Newton printed it in 1779 in Olney Hymns, Book I, no. 76, under Zechariah 2:10.
Zechariah 2:10 the verse printed above it
The words as Newton printed them, 28 lines.
Newton printed the hymn under Zechariah 2:10. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
“Shout for joy and be glad, O Daughter of Zion, for I am coming to dwell among you,” declares the LORD. ZECHARIAH 2:10 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ ZECHARIAH 2
Son of God! thy people’s shield! Must we still thine absence mourn? Let thy promise be fulfilled, Thou hast said, “I will return!” STANZA I
